'''Adam Swiftgale''' was a [[Rockhopper]] jockey from [[Manda/Legends|Manda]]. At the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], he attended [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia's]] pilot briefing before heading to his ship, flying under the callsign [[Green Three/Legends|Green Three]].<ref name="Rogues Gallery" />

==Behind the scenes==
Adam Swiftgale was first identified in "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery: Clearance for Immediate Launch]]" in [[Star Wars Insider 146|''Star Wars Insider'' 146]].<ref name="Rogues Gallery" />
